# Configuration reference

Every field of `vlmrl.trainer.TrainConfig`, the Hydra schema. Set any of them on the command line (`python scripts/train.py field=value`) or in a YAML group file. See [Configuration](../training/configuration.md) for how the groups compose.

*default* is the value after the default Hydra groups are applied (`policy=qwen3vl4b_lora task=pointmaze rollout=hf`), i.e. what `python scripts/train.py` runs with.

## model

| field | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | `str` | `'Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct'` |  |
| `processor_kwargs` | `dict` | `{}` | e.g. {"max_pixels": 200704} / {"do_image_splitting": false} |
| `dtype` | `str` | `'auto'` |  |
| `attn_implementation` | `str \| None` | `null` | e.g. "flash_attention_2" / "sdpa" |
| `gradient_checkpointing` | `bool` | `True` |  |
| `lora_rank` | `int` | `64` | 0 = full fine-tuning |
| `lora_alpha` | `int` | `128` |  |
| `lora_targets` | `str` | `'.*language_model.*\\.(q_proj\|k_proj\|v_proj\|o_proj\|gate_proj\|up_proj\|down_proj)'` | PEFT target_modules; a regex string also works |

## rollout backend

| field | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rollout_backend` | `str` | `'hf'` | "hf" (in-process generate) \| "vllm" (server, LoRA only) |
| `vllm_url` | `str` | `'http://localhost:8000'` |  |

## task

| field | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `env` | `str` | `'pointmaze'` | registry name or "module:factory" |
| `env_kwargs` | `dict` | `{'maze': 'umaze', 'max_turns': 10, 'image_size': 336, 'include_state': True, 'prompt_style': 'pear', 'settle': True, 'start_states': 'random', 'eval_start_states': 'random', 'min_goal_dist': 1.5}` |  |
| `reward` | `str` | `'success'` | see rewards.build_reward |
| `max_images` | `int \| None` | `null` | None = full multi-image history (PEAR); k = keep last k |

## RL

| field | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | `int` | `200` |  |
| `groups_per_step` | `int` | `8` | PEAR: 128 |
| `group_size` | `int` | `8` | PEAR: 8 |
| `filter_groups` | `bool` | `True` | DAPO group filter |
| `max_resample_rounds` | `int` | `3` |  |
| `adv_mode` | `str` | `'zscore'` | zscore (GRPO, PEAR Eq. 1) \| center \| rloo |
| `policy_loss` | `str` | `'reinforce'` | reinforce (PEAR "bypass", no clipping) \| ppo_clip |
| `ppo_epochs` | `int` | `1` | updates per batch; 1 = PEAR |
| `score_centering` | `bool` | `True` | PEAR: correct rollout/learner mismatch (active when off-policy) |
| `score_centering_topk` | `int` | `32` | rollout-policy support used for the correction |
| `on_invalid` | `str` | `'terminate'` | PEAR: an invalid action ends the episode \| "noop" |
| `max_context_tokens` | `int \| None` | `null` | PEAR: episode ends when the context budget is reached |
| `clip_low` | `float` | `0.2` |  |
| `clip_high` | `float` | `0.28` |  |

## optim

| field | type | default | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lr` | `float` | `2e-05` | PEAR (27B full FT); LoRA on small models wants ~1e-5..1e-4 |
| `weight_decay` | `float` | `0.0` |  |
| `grad_clip` | `float` | `1.0` |  |
| `micro_batch_size` | `int` | `1` | sequences per forward/backward |
